# Thomas Kneale & Co Ltd

> > Contract textile supplier specializing in fire retardant bedding, anti-ligature products, and BS7175-compliant textiles for education, custodial, and hospitality sectors.

Thomas Kneale & Co Ltd, based in Manchester, is an employee-owned textile manufacturer serving education, custodial (MOJ), MOD, and emergency service sectors. The company specializes in BS7175, BS5852, and BS5815 compliant products including flame retardant curtains, anti-ligature bedding, and contract-quality linens.

## Key Topics

- Fire retardant textiles (BS7175, BS5852)
- Anti-ligature products for secure environments
- Contract textiles for education sector
- Custodial and secure environment textiles
- Arbry® High Security Blanket
- Flame retardant curtains (Crib 5/7)
- Student bedding packs
- Ring-spun vs open-end cotton yarn
- Employee Ownership Trust
- Living Wage Foundation accreditation
- ISO 14001 environmental certification
- Oeko-Tex certified textiles
- Ministry of Justice (MOJ) supplier
- Self-harm prevention products
- BS5815 seclusion blankets

## Fire Retardant & Safety Products

- [Our Flame & Fire Retardant Range](https://www.thomaskneale.co.uk/flame-retardant-range): BS 7175 compliant flame retardant bedding, curtains & textiles range
- [Fire Retardant Curtains](https://www.thomaskneale.co.uk/fire-retardant-curtains): BS 7175 Crib 5/7 fire retardant curtains, blackout & dimout options
- [Fire Retardant Pillows & Duvets](https://www.thomaskneale.co.uk/wholesale-pillows-duvets/fire-retardant-pillows-duvets): BS5852 & BS7175 fire retardant pillows & duvets for contract use
- [Mattresses](https://www.thomaskneale.co.uk/mattresses): BS7177 fire retardant foam & sprung mattresses for contract use

## Anti-Ligature & Secure Environment Products

- [Anti-Ligature Products](https://www.thomaskneale.co.uk/anti-ligature-products): Anti-ligature products for secure environments meeting BS standards
- [Seclusion Blankets](https://www.thomaskneale.co.uk/wholesale-blankets/seclusion-blankets): BS5815 anti-ligature seclusion blankets for secure custodial environments

- [Market Sectors Overview](https://www.thomaskneale.co.uk/market-sectors): Textiles for education, custodial, MOJ, MOD & emergency service sectors

- [Student Bedding Packs](https://www.thomaskneale.co.uk/student-packs-university/student-bedding-packs): Vacuum-packed student bedding sets for university accommodation

- [Bed Linen](https://www.thomaskneale.co.uk/bed-linen): Contract quality bed linen including Egyptian cotton & Oeko-Tex certified
- [Hotel Quality Pillows & Duvets](https://www.thomaskneale.co.uk/wholesale-pillows-duvets/hotel-pillow-duvets): BS5852 hotel quality pillows & duvets in polyester or feather & down
